stemMarkdown: A shop offers two successive discounts of 10% and 20% on an item. What single discount percentage is equivalent to these two? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Take MP $= 100$. After 10%: $90$. After a further 20%: $72.00$. The total discount is $100 - 72.00 = 28.0\%$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equivalent discount $= d_1 + d_2 - \dfrac{d_1 d_2}{100} = 10 + 20 - \dfrac{200}{100} = 28.0\%$. Note it is **not** $30\%$.
